slides.title: It's November... you know what that means.
Listings slow down. The paperwork does not.
slides.body: Somebody has to deal with it. Spoiler: it's you.

slides.title: Finding out which agents' licenses expire before the new year.
slides.body: One of them is 'pretty sure' theirs is fine.

slides.title: The E&O renewal notice turns up under a stack of open house signs.
slides.body: Next to last year's open house cookies.

slides.title: Asking who has the login to renew the brokerage license.
slides.body: The answer is an agent who moved to another office in June.

slides.label: It's time.
slides.title: (to check the renewal dates)
slides.body: Save this before the holiday party gets planned.
